metadata.title: Recommendations to Reduce the Risk of Transmission of Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) by Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and Tissue-Based Products (HCT/Ps): Draft Guidance for Industry
metadata.topic: Draft guideline · FDA human drugs and biologics
metadata.legal_basis: FDA Guidance Document (21 CFR 10.115). Guidance states FDA's current thinking and is not binding unless a statute or regulation requires it; the official text governs.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.

candidates.statement: Unless an exception identified in 21 CFR 1271.90(a) applies, you must review relevant 423 medical records for clinical evidence of relevant communicable disease agents and 424 diseases (21 CFR 1271.75). In accordance with 21 CFR 1271.75(d), you must determine 425 to be ineligible any potential donor who exhibits clinical evidence of HBV (Refs. 4, 43, 426 83-84). Examples of clinical evidence of HBV may include: 427 • A prior positive or reactive screening test for HBV; 428 • Unexplained jaundice; 429 • Unexplained hepatomegaly; 430 • Generalized lymphadenopathy; and/or 431 • Unexplained generalized rash or fever. 432
